# contexts

:::info[Typed specification]

Generated by the pinned `ess generate --kind docs` from [`adapters/kubernetes/spec/ess`](https://github.com/beyond10x/connectors/tree/main/adapters/kubernetes/spec/ess). Structural validation establishes consistency; behaviour, storage and cross-record predicates remain implementation obligations.

Kubernetes-owned projection of the contexts of the kubeconfig a local connection was configured with.

`connectors_kubernetes.contexts` is one of connectors_kubernetes's bounded contexts. [Back to the index](../index.md).

## Types

### `KubeconfigContext`

`connectors_kubernetes.contexts.KubeconfigContext` is a record of four fields:

- `name` — `String`
- `cluster` — `String`
- `namespace` — `Optional<String>`, which may be absent
- `current` — `Boolean`

Every value satisfies `(name.count >= 1 and name.count <= 256)`, `(cluster.count >= 1 and cluster.count <= 256)` and `(not (defined(namespace)) or (namespace.count >= 1 and namespace.count <= 63))`.

### `KubeconfigSource`

`connectors_kubernetes.contexts.KubeconfigSource` is a record of one field:

- `path_digest` — `String`

Every value satisfies `(path_digest.count >= 64 and path_digest.count <= 64)`.

Two of the types above are reached by nothing else in this system: `connectors_kubernetes.contexts.KubeconfigContext` and `connectors_kubernetes.contexts.KubeconfigSource`. No entity, view, command, event, error or crossing names them, so it is either vocabulary something outside this specification uses or a leftover — and only a person can tell which.
